sentences.text: Pintu Agarwala vs Unknown on 23 July, 2018

1
18 23.07.2018
Ab Court 28
 C.R.M. 4881 of 2018
In Re : An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection
with Karimpur P.S. Case No.103 of 2018 dated 12.6.2018 under Sections 272/273 420/120B of the
Indian Penal Code read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act And In the
matter of : Pintu Agarwala ...Petitioner.
Mr. Bhaskar Sen, Sr. Advocate, Mr. Atis Kr. Biswas ...for the Petitioner.
Mr. Ranabir Roychoudhury, Mr. Mainak Gupta ...for the State.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is in custody for 40 days and that the incriminating article has already been seized.
Hence, further detention is not necessary in the facts of the case.
Learned lawyer appearing for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that the report of the chemical examiner is awaited in the instant case.
We have considered the materials on record and we find that the incriminating article has already been seized.

In view of the aforesaid fact and bearing in mind the nature of allegations and the fact that the report of the chemical examiner has not been received as yet, we are inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-(Rupees Ten Thousand only) with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom shall be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta on condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing and shall not intimidate witnesses nor tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever and on further condition that he shall meet the Investigating Officer of the case once a week until further orders.
In the event the petitioner fails to appear before the trial court, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail without further reference to this Court.
The application for bail is, accordingly, allowed.
Certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied expeditiously after complying with all necessary legal formalities.

(Ravi Krishan Kapur, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
